contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SOLI INVI[CTO C]OMI[TI] ; D/ IMP [CONSTANTI]NVS P F AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine I, AD 306-337 (Reece period 15). Reverse legend reads SOLI INVI[CTO C]OMI[TI]. Reverse shows Sol standing left, raising right hand and holding globe in left. Uncertain mint, AD 313-318. Obverse legend reads IMP [CONSTANTI]NVS P F AVG. Obverse shows a laureate and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue illegible. Die axis is 12 o'clock.
